name: tokendoctor
description: The same Claude Code for up to 38% less. Replays your own past sessions to show what each change would have saved, then changes only what you pick.

slide.title: Slide the window instead of compacting
slide.description: Where Claude Code would summarize the conversation, elide old tool outputs instead (they can be read again): no summary request, every prompt and answer kept word for word. /compact still summarizes.

keepalive.title: Keep the prompt cache warm through a pause
keepalive.description: Shortly before the one-hour prompt cache of a conversation of 200K tokens or more expires, send a one-word fork of it, so the next message reads the conversation from the cache instead of writing it again. Never on a cache that may be cold; a few pings a pause, fewer when you rarely come back.

slideTo.title: Slide down to (% of where Claude Code compacts)
slideTo.description: How far a slide frees the context, as a percent of the point where Claude Code compacts (20 to 90). Lower leaves less behind and more turns before the next slide.
